Before that, Patrick Francke, MD, FACRO, earned a Bachelor of Science in Biology from Western Kentucky University in Bowling Green, KY, and a Doctor of Medicine degree from the University of Louisville School of Medicine in Louisville, KY. Throughout his career, Patrick Francke, MD, FACRO, has made significant contributions to the field, publishing and lecturing on various topics, including Gynecologic Oncology, Lung Cancer, and Brachytherapy. Dr. Francke’s notable publications showcase his involvement in cutting-edge research, with topics ranging from the benefits of rectal separation for prostate radiation therapy to innovative approaches in the delivery of high-dose radiation for intermediate- to high-risk prostate cancer. His expertise extends to various specialties, including intensity-modulated radiation therapy (IMRT), image-guided radiation therapy (IGRT), stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT), stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS), and volumetric modulated arc therapy (VMAT). fields.Board Certification: Heather Baldassarri brings exceptional surgical expertise and a passionate commitment to patient advocacy to CMC's Surgical Associates team. With ten years of experience in trauma and surgical critical care, Heather understands the full spectrum of surgical patient needs, from the most complex emergencies to routine procedures requiring careful attention to detail. What sets Heather apart is her unwavering dedication to patient safety and advocacy. Having cared for critically ill patients for years, she's developed an exceptional ability to anticipate needs, recognize complications early, and fight for patients who can't fight for themselves. Her transition from critical care to general surgery represents her desire to provide continuity of care, being with patients from their pre-operative consultation through their complete recovery. Heather's patients appreciate her comprehensive approach to surgical care. Working alongside Dr. Aaron Epstein, she ensures that every patient receives a thorough evaluation, clear communication about their procedure, and attentive follow-up care. Her extensive procedural experience – from complex catheter placements to managing ventilators – gives her unique insight into potential complications and how to prevent them. Having completed a specialized Physician Assistant Surgical Critical Care Residency, Heather brings academic excellence to her practice. Her Summa Cum Laude graduation from the New York Institute of Technology and multiple certifications, including Advanced Trauma Life Support reflect her commitment to providing the highest quality care. What drives Heather is witnessing patients' transformation through surgical intervention – whether it's a life-saving procedure or cancer surgery that offers hope for a cure. She finds deep satisfaction in being part of a team that can step in when patients need help most, providing not just technical expertise but genuine compassion and advocacy. After moving south from New York in 2022, Heather has made the Grand Strand her home and is excited to serve the Horry County community through expert surgical care that prioritizes both clinical excellence and patient well-being.

name: Chase Witter, DPM · Conway Medical Center Find a Doc

fields.Board Certification: Dr. Chase Witter brings genuine passion for patient healing to Conway Medical Center's Orthopaedic department. His journey into podiatry began when he worked as a certified nursing assistant in a long-term care facility and witnessed a podiatrist transforming patients' lives through wound care and limb salvage. "I realized there's not much more rewarding than healing a wound and helping somebody keep their limb," Dr. Witter says – and that commitment guides his practice every day. Dr. Witter treats a full range of foot and ankle conditions, from common issues like bunions, hammertoes, and plantar fasciitis to more complex problems like fractures, sprains, tendonitis, and diabetic foot wounds. What sets him apart is his conservative approach – he exhausts conservative treatment options before considering surgery, believing in giving patients the best chance at healing with the least invasive methods possible. Whether you're dealing with everyday foot pain, a sports-related ankle injury, or a complex diabetic foot wound, Dr. Witter combines clinical expertise with genuine compassion and a clear commitment to keeping you mobile and active.

name: Farayi Mbuvah, MD · Conway Medical Center Find a Doc

fields.Board Certification: Farayi Jonnes Mbuvah, MD, is pain fellowship trained and double board-certified in anesthesiology and pain medicine. He graduated at the top of his class from the University of Zimbabwe Godfrey Huggins School of Medicine in Harare, Zimbabwe, in 2003. He then practiced medicine in Africa as an OB/GYN for five years before moving to the USA. In 2012, he relocated to Cleveland to pursue an internal medicine residency at Fairview Hospital/ Cleveland Clinic. Following the Internal medicine residency, Dr. Mbuvah moved to Henry Ford Hospital in Detroit for an anesthesiology residency. He graduated from the Henry Ford anesthesiology residency with multiple awards and accolades for academic and clinical excellence from the American Board of Anesthesiology (ABA). In his final year of residency, he served as chief resident for the Anesthesiology residency program. He then moved on to a Pain medicine fellowship at Henry Ford Hospital, where he trained in cutting-edge interventional pain procedures under the tutelage of reputable pain physicians. Dr. Mbuvah and his wife, Dr. Desiree Aird with their son Cayden then moved to the Myrtle beach area to work at a local pain clinic as part of his visa requirements. His family fell in love with life at the beach they decided to stay and settle in the Myrtle Beach area. With extensive experience in internal medicine, obstetrics and gynecology, and pain medicine, Dr. Mbuvah provides exceptional, compassionate care for patients suffering from a wide range of pain syndromes including but not limited to neck pain, back pain, headaches, thoracic pain, abdominal pain, joint pain, neuropathy, and cancer-associated pain. Dr. Mbuvah listens to his patients and tailors his treatment plan for each patient. He focuses on non-opioid therapies/interventions and offers a wide range of FDA-approved, cutting-edge therapies including nerve blocks, radiofrequency ablations, epidural steroid injections, joint injections as well as more complex pain interventions such as spinal cord stimulator trials, peripheral nerve stimulator trials/implants, intrathecal pain pump trials with Morphine/maintenance, minimally invasive sacroiliac joint fusions, kyphoplasty/vertebroplasty as minimally invasive spine procedures (MILD procedure, Vertiflex procedure, and MINUTEMAN) for patients with lumbar spinal stenosis/neurogenic claudication who are not surgical candidates or prefer not to have invasive surgeries. Dr. Mbuvah has been a resident of Horry county for 3 years and loves the wonderful people he has met over the years, especially their southern hospitality. He is committed to contributing positively to the well-being of the Horry county residents and is grateful to be part of a wonderful health system, CMC, whose values align really well with what he believes in too. When he isn’t working with patients to diagnose and treat pain, Dr. Mbuvah loves spending time with his family, cycling, and working out. name: Micheal Odle, MD · Conway Medical Center Find a Doc

fields.Board Certification: Board Certified in Cardiovascular Disease by the American Board of IM/Cardiovascular Disease Board Certified in Internal Medicine by the American Board of Internal Medicine Fellowship trained at Brooke Army Medical Center Dr. Michael Odle is the Chief of Cardiology at Conway Medical Center and is a key member of the team at CMC Cardiology. Dr. Michael Odle grew up in the mountains of southern West Virginia. He spent a lot of time outdoors hunting and fishing. His father and grandfathers were hard-working coal miners. When it came time for him to choose a career, he said the fast-paced atmosphere and technology led him to medicine. Now, it’s something else that keeps him happy in the field. “I love listening to patients and hearing their stories. I also want to be a part of helping people and making their lives better.” He went to Marshall University for undergraduate and medical school. When it came time to choose a specialty, he was not sure which to choose, at least until he had the opportunity as a third-year medical student to be in the catheterization lab for a heart procedure. “That was it for me. I knew that was what I wanted to do.” After medical school, he joined the U.S. Army and has spent the last two decades on active duty. Most recently he served at Fort Gordon’s Eisenhower Army Medical Center in Augusta in a variety of roles including chief of cardiology and program director of the internal medicine residency. He just retired as a colonel after 20 years. He says while he and his wife both enjoyed his career in the Army, they promised themselves several years ago that when he retired, they would move to the beach. While the lure of beach is what brought them to Conway Medical Center, it was the interview process that sealed the deal. He says they fell in love with the people here, and it was not a difficult decision to come to work at CMC Cardiology. “It’s a very family-type atmosphere. It’s a small cardiology program, but big enough to do everything that I wanted to do. I felt like I could play a pivotal role here in making things better for the hospital and advancing the care of the patients in the surrounding community.” He and his wife, who he met in junior high school, have been married for 25 years. They have five children. While being a cardiologist does not leave him a lot of free time, he enjoys fishing with his children and spending time on the beach with his wife. He really looks forward to meeting patients and helping them live happier, healthier lives.

name: Snigdha Sharma, MD · Conway Medical Center Find a Doc

fields.Board Certification: Board Certified in Pulmonary Disease by the American Board of Internal Medicine Board Certified in Internal Medicine by the American Board of Internal Medicine Fellowship Trained in Internal Medicine at Detroit Medical Center Fellowship Trained in Pulmonology at Detroit Medical Center Dr. Snigdha Sharma grew up in India in a family of professionals, surrounded by doctors and engineers. In law school, she always wondered how to cope in a profession defining and choosing right from wrong. Following her mother's footsteps, she felt medicine to be a moral calling, where one always strives to help others. “At the end of the day, you are doing right by your patients. You are helping them in whatever capacity you can. That is probably the most rewarding part of medicine. I think as hard as the journey is, that’s the reason doctors get into it. You end up devoting fifteen-plus years of your life studying, but I feel the gratification you derive if your patient does well, that is absolutely unmatched,” she said. A year into law school, she made the tough decision to pursue medical school, where she ended up eventually meeting her future husband. After graduating medical school, they continued their educational interests by pursuing advanced training in the United States. In the course of seven years in Detroit, Dr. Sharma did her residency in internal medicine, chief residency and fellowship in pulmonary/critical care. After her fellowship, they began looking for a place to call home and practice medicine. They interviewed at a lot of hospitals - “We wanted to start out our careers in a place that is growing and evolving. Here at Conway Medical Center, we felt there is a vision. There are a lot of big healthcare systems, but there are very few that are so deeply rooted in the community. To start out our careers at a system like that, I think that’s really amazing.” In August 2020, she began working at CMC Pulmonology. Her husband, Dr. Aditya Sood, is a cardiologist at CMC Cardiology. While she said with a smile that medicine leaves very little time for hobbies, she and her husband have a dog. “Most of the time when we are not at the hospital, we love spending time outdoors with her. We also love traveling.” She said beginning her medical career, especially in pulmonology, during COVID has been challenging. Still, she believes there are lessons to be learned from it. “When it comes to our health, I truly feel there are a lot of factors that are beyond our control and we are dealt the cards we are dealt, but it is so important to value what we have. I think we have realized that through this pandemic. Nothing can replace the body that God has given you, I feel that many of our pulmonary conditions are related to environmental factors around us today, especially such as smoking and e-cigarette use."

name: Christian Whittington, MD · Conway Medical Center Find a Doc

fields.Board Certification: From a very early age, Dr. Christian Whittington was a worker. He started by tying the lawnmower to the back of his bicycle and hauling it around their neighborhood in Wichita, Kansas to mow yards. He also knew early on that he wanted to go into medicine. He was inspired by his own family doctor who encouraged the 10-year-old by allowing him to shadow him and follow him around in his medical practice. Dr. Whittington earned degrees in Biology and Chemistry from the University of Tulsa and graduated from the University of Kansas School of Medicine. During his residency in Wichita, he knew he wanted to go into primary care. “I like surgery, but I didn’t like standing in the same spot all day long,” he said with a smile. “Everything else, I got bored. Family medicine is exciting because you never know what is coming through the door. I get to do something different every single day.” For the last 25 years, he practiced in western Kansas, where he was the only doctor for several miles in any direction. That meant he wore a lot of hats in his community. “I did everything. I was the ER director, I admitted to the hospital, I was the EMS director, and so clinic work here is kind of a partial retirement for me.” He’s now seeing patients at CMC Primary Care Highway 90. He says his favorite part of the job is the relationships he builds with patients and getting to talk with people all day long. “The medical part of it is pretty straightforward. It’s the personal part that I enjoy. I sit and I talk. They’re not long conversations, but I get to have conversations with some very interesting people every single day.” If his patients were to ask about his hobbies outside of work, he would quickly tell them about his number one passion. “I love to cook. I have a vertical and a horizontal smoker. I actually competed in the Kansas City BBQ Classic a couple of times. I like to smoke BBQ. I got an outdoor pizza oven for Christmas this year, so that’s going to be my new hobby, figuring out all the things I can do with that.” He and his wife have three children, ages 22, 20, and the youngest who is a high school sophomore.

name: John Stelmach, MD · Conway Medical Center Find a Doc

fields.Board Certification: Dr. John Stelmach brings exceptional training and a legacy of orthopedic excellence to Conway Medical Center's Orthopaedic department. Specializing in adult reconstruction and total joint surgery, Dr. Stelmach combines the latest technological advances with compassionate, personalized patient care. What sets Dr. Stelmach apart is his extensive experience with both traditional and robotic-assisted surgical techniques. Having completed over 600 total joint cases, including advanced training on the Stryker Mako robotic system, he offers patients access to the most precise and minimally invasive surgical options available. His fellowship training under renowned specialists has prepared him to handle even the most complex joint reconstruction cases. Dr. Stelmach understands that joint problems can significantly impact your quality of life, limiting everything from daily activities to the sports and hobbies you love. His approach focuses on getting you back to the activities that matter most to you, whether that's playing with your children, returning to the golf course, or simply walking without pain. He takes time to thoroughly evaluate your condition and explain all treatment options, from conservative approaches to advanced surgical interventions. Having grown up in a medical family – his father was also an orthopedic surgeon for nearly 40 years – Dr. Stelmach developed an early appreciation for the importance of building lasting doctor-patient relationships. This background instilled in him both the technical excellence and compassionate approach that define his practice. Dr. Stelmach has a special connection to the Conway area, having visited for years on golf trips with college friends. He and his wife, a high school English teacher, are excited to raise their two young sons in a community that offers both small-town values and access to excellent amenities. Their family enjoys exploring nature parks and discovering new places together. Dr. Stelmach looks forward to helping patients throughout the region achieve better mobility and return to active, pain-free lives through expert orthopedic care. Specializations : Adult reconstruction and total joint surgery Stryker Mako robotic-assisted surgery certified Advanced minimally invasive techniques

fields.Board Certification: When you meet Dr. Sudeepthi Bandikatla, you'll immediately sense her genuine commitment to helping you through your cancer journey. As a hematology/oncology specialist at Conway Medical Center, Dr. Bandikatla believes that fighting cancer is a team effort – and you're at the center of that team. Dr. Bandikatla brings cutting-edge expertise from one of the nation's top cancer centers, the renowned Moffitt Cancer Center in Florida, where she completed advanced training in blood cancers and innovative treatments like immunotherapy. What sets her apart is her dedication to personalized care – she takes time to understand not just your medical needs, but you as a whole person. Understanding that every patient's cancer story is unique, Dr. Bandikatla focuses on creating treatment plans that fit your specific situation, your goals, and your life. She specializes in blood cancers and is passionate about bringing the latest breakthroughs in precision medicine and immunotherapy to her patients right here in Conway. Beyond her medical expertise, Dr. Bandikatla is known for her clear communication style – she'll make sure you understand your diagnosis, treatment options, and what to expect every step of the way. Her patients appreciate her patience in answering questions and her commitment to involving them in every decision. When she's not caring for patients, you might find Dr. Bandikatla exploring new running trails, experimenting with recipes from different cultures, or planning her next travel adventure. Her curiosity about the world translates into her practice, where she's always seeking the newest and best treatments for her patients. Dr. Bandikatla is excited to call Conway home and looks forward to building lasting relationships with patients and families throughout the community.

He then earned his Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine degree from Lake Erie College of Osteopathic Medicine in Bradenton, FL. Following medical school, Dr. Sussman completed his orthopedic surgery residency at HCA Florida Healthcare/USF Morsani College of Medicine in Largo, FL. While in residency, Dr. Sussman began pursuing his interest in sports medicine by covering several high schools. After residency, He completed a sports medicine fellowship at Orlando Regional Medical Center. During his fellowship, he had the opportunity to work as a team physician for the University of Central Florida's football and basketball teams, the Orlando City SC professional soccer team, the Arnold Palmer Invitational, and the 2022 Special Olympics equestrian events. After fellowship, Dr. Sussman spent his first two years in private practice in southwest Virginia/northeast Tennessee, providing general orthopedic care to the community as well as sports coverage to Emory and Henry College and several area high schools. In addition to collegiate sports coverage, Dr. Sussman will also have the opportunity to provide specialized sports, shoulder, and knee care to the community of Conway, Myrtle Beach, and surrounding areas. Dr. Sussman specialized in sports medicine and arthroscopic surgery of the shoulder and knee. He also specializes in shoulder replacement procedures in addition to the ream and run procedure, which is reserved for patients who are young but with significant arthritis of the shoulder. He also has had training in orthopedic trauma and fracture care. He has a particular focus on the prevention and treatment of orthopedic conditions affecting patients of all ages. Dr. Sussman has a particular interest in ligament, tendon, and cartilage injuries of the shoulder and knee, in addition to shoulder replacement surgery. Dr. Sussman has extensive experience with sports coverage during his training and years in private practice. He has provided care to patients at all levels of sports, from professional sports to weekend warriors. When not seeing patients, Dr. Sussman and his wife, Heather, enjoy spending time with their dogs, a sulcata tortoise, and a non-releasable squirrel. name: Daniel Reid, MD · Orthopedic Surgeon Myrtle Beach · Conway, SC

fields.Board Certification: Fellowship trained in Spine Surgery at the San Diego Spine Foundation Fellowship trained in Orthopaedic Trauma at Brown University Board Certified in Orthopaedic Surgery by the American Board of Orthopaedic Surgery Providers: To submit a referral for an appointment with Dr. Reid, please fax it to 843-347-8042 Daniel B.C. Reid, MD, MPH completed his undergraduate education at the University of Washington, where he received a Bachelor of Science (BS) degree in Psychology with College Honors. He earned his medical degree (MD) from Tulane University in New Orleans, LA. In addition to earning his MD, Dr. Reid was formally trained in epidemiology with the Tulane University School of Public Health while completing his medical school training. He graduated in 2014 with dual MD and MPH degrees. Following medical school, Dr. Reid completed his Orthopaedic Surgery residency at Brown University in Providence, RI. After residency, he completed an orthopaedic trauma fellowship at Brown University. This was followed by a Spine Surgery fellowship with the San Diego Spine Foundation at Scripps Clinic in San Diego, CA, where Dr. Reid received extensive and comprehensive training in both traditional and modern minimally invasive spine surgery techniques. Dr. Reid is a board-certified orthopaedic surgeon specializing in surgery of the spine. He also has advanced training in orthopaedic trauma and fracture care. He focuses on the prevention and treatment of spinal conditions affecting patients of all ages. Dr. Reid treats all areas of the spine, including the neck, back, low back, and pelvis. He is committed to providing compassionate, evidence-based care for his patients. He guides patients through the diagnosis and treatment of various spinal conditions, generally focusing first on non-operative modalities, and only pursuing surgical intervention when conservative measures have failed. When spine surgery is required, Dr. Reid has specific interests in minimally invasive techniques in order to reduce postoperative pain, facilitate faster recovery, and improve patient outcomes. He also regularly utilizes state-of-the-art technology, such as robotics and computer-assisted 3D navigation, in order to improve surgical accuracy and maximize patient satisfaction. Dr. Reid has authored numerous publications and book chapters. He serves as a peer-reviewer for two prestigious journals focused on the spine. He has presented his research at a number of national conferences. While he has published on a number of topics relevant to orthopaedic and spine surgery, his primary research interests include outcomes following surgery for adult spinal deformity, and strategies for minimizing opioid requirements following surgery. In his time away from work, Dr. Reid and his wife, Andrea, enjoy spending time with their two children, Adeline and Miles. As a family, they enjoy spending time at the beach, hiking, and supporting the children in their various athletic endeavors. Dr. Reid is also a musician and enjoys playing multiple instruments in his free time. He is most proficient at the guitar.

name: Daniel E. Boykin, DO · Conway Medical Center Find a Doc

fields.Board Certification: Board Certified in Family Medicine I have always had a strong passion for helping others and realized that from my interests, strengths, and aspirations I was destined for something in the medical field. Having worked in emergency medical services for several years before going to medical school, I’m strongly driven to help treat and educate patients to alter the path of preventable illness. Providing effective health care is a team accomplishment, but my philosophy on primary care is that it requires comfort working in a gray zone. What is best for one patient does not make sense for another and what we practiced five years ago, in some cases, is no longer the standard of care today. It is important to me to gain the trust and respect of my patients through maintaining up-to-date knowledge, active listening, empathy, and providing a spirit of encouragement. I strive to help patients move the needle together in order to accomplish their health goals. My areas of special interest include chronic disease management, specifically obesity, and diabetes. Outside of work, I spend most of my free time with my family including my amazing wife and two young, rambunctious sons. I enjoy spending time at the beach, baseball, reading, watching movies, and cooking.

name: Samuel Andersen, MD · Conway Medical Center Find a Doc

fields.Board Certification: Samuel Andersen, MD, a board-certified radiation oncologist, holds a Doctor of Allopathic Medicine degree from the Medical University of South Carolina in Charleston, SC. He is a proud alumnus of The University of Alabama Honors College in Tuscaloosa, AL, where he graduated summa cum laude with a Bachelor of Science degree in Biology and a minor degree in the Randall Research Scholars Program. He completed a four-year residency in radiation oncology at the University of Texas Health San Antonio MD Anderson Cancer Center, where he served as a Chief Resident in his final two years. Prior to his advanced program training, he completed a transitional year internship at Grand Strand Medical Center in Myrtle Beach, SC. During residency, he participated in research and published academic articles on topics including standardizing patient care and reducing treatment-associated toxicity. As a Chief Resident, he was responsible for providing lectures to help train the next generation of radiation oncologists. He is passionate about education, with an emphasis on patient education – he strives to answer questions regarding radiation therapy and patient care plans, and he strongly believes in shared-decision making. Dr. Andersen believes in a wholistic, patient-centered approach to care. He understands that treatment with radiation therapy can be a frightening prospect, but he also believes in its role in the comprehensive care of malignant conditions. He is also excited about its complimentary use in the management of some benign conditions such as osteoarthritis, arteriovenous malformations, and keloidal scars, to name a few. He is skilled in the treatment of prostate, genitourinary, gynecological, gastrointestinal, thoracic, head and neck, hematological, central nervous system, connective tissue, and cutaneous malignancies. He has significant experience in many radiation treatment techniques including 3D conformal radiation therapy (3D-CRT), electron therapy, high dose-rate (HDR) brachytherapy, intensity modulated radiation therapy (IMRT), image-guided IMRT (IG-IMRT), volumetric modulated arc therapy (VMAT), stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT), stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS), and radiopharmaceutical administration. fields.Board Certification: Dr. William Wheeler brings exceptional surgical expertise and compassionate care to Conway Medical Center's Wound Care department. As a board-certified general surgeon with decades of experience, Dr. Wheeler understands that chronic wounds can significantly impact your quality of life, and he's dedicated to helping you heal completely and prevent future complications. What sets Dr. Wheeler apart is his comprehensive background in surgery, academics, and specialized wound care. Having served as chief of surgery at multiple hospitals and as a tenured associate professor at Marshall University, he combines extensive clinical experience with the latest evidence-based treatments. His six years working in burn units and over 30 published articles reflect his deep commitment to advancing wound care medicine. Dr. Wheeler's approach to treatment goes beyond just healing your current wound – he focuses on addressing underlying causes and helping you make lifestyle changes that promote healing and prevent recurrence. His patients appreciate his thorough evaluation process and his use of the most advanced wound care technologies, including hyperbaric oxygen therapy, biological products, and negative pressure wound therapy. Having dedicated his career entirely to wound care after 15 years in private practice, Dr. Wheeler brings both surgical precision and specialized wound healing expertise to every patient interaction. He takes time to educate patients about their conditions and treatment options, ensuring you're an active partner in your healing journey. Dr. Wheeler's commitment to helping others extends well beyond the clinic. He actively participates in community service through Meals on Wheels, local soup kitchens, and first responder work. His mission trips to the Dominican Republic, where he provides wound care and surgical services, reflect his dedication to making healthcare accessible to those in need. Dr. Wheeler and his wife, a school nurse, share a passion for healthcare and community service. They enjoy spending time with their two sons and three grandsons, traveling, playing golf, and participating in church activities. Their dog Yaya is also an important part of their family. Dr. Wheeler looks forward to helping patients in Conway achieve complete healing and return to their active lifestyles through expert, compassionate wound care.

name: Donovan Johnson, MD · Orthopedic Doctor Myrtle Beach · Conway, SC

fields.Board Certification: Fellowship trained in Sports Medicine: Shoulder, Elbow, Hip and Knee Arthroscopy at The Steadman Clinic, Steadman-Philippon Research Institute, Vail CO. Board Certified in Orthopaedic Surgery by the American Board of Orthopaedic Surgery Donovan Johnson MD completed his undergraduate education at Eastern Illinois University, where he received a bachelor’s degree in Biology and was a starter on their football team. He was an all-conference defensive end and linebacker. He earned his medical degree from Georgetown University located in Washington, D.C. Following medical school, Dr. Johnson completed his orthopedic surgery residency at Tulane University in New Orleans, LA. While in New Orleans, he served as head team-physician for two local high schools, both of which were state champions in their division. After residency, he completed a sports medicine fellowship at the world-renowned and prestigious Steadman Clinic located in Vail, CO. The Steadman Clinic is one of the most sought-after sports medicine fellowships for orthopaedic surgeons. Dr. Johnson specializes in sports medicine , arthroscopic surgery of the shoulder, elbow, hip, and knee. To note, he is one of the only specialists in the Grand Strand region who specializes in complex hip arthroscopy surgery. He also has advanced training in orthopedic trauma and fracture care and joint replacement surgery. He focuses on the prevention and treatment of orthopedic conditions affecting patients of all ages. Dr. Johnson has specific interests in treating ligament, tendon and cartilage injuries of the shoulder, hip, and knee. Dr. Johnson has additional training in treating complex disorders of the hip which includes non-surgical and surgical treatment of femoroacetabular impingement, hip preservation and extra-articular tendon injuries involving the hip. Dating back to 2015, Dr. Johnson has been fortunate to serve as team physicians to various sports organizations, including Tulane University Athletics (NCAA FBS Football, Basketball, Baseball and Track and Field). He is currently one of the US Ski and Snowboard Teams team physician and has covered several Premier Lacrosse League (PLL) events. He also has treated multiple players from the NBA, NFL, MLB and various athletes from the high school and collegiate level. He is the current head team physician for Carolina Forest High School located in Myrtle Beach, SC. In his time away from work, Dr. Johnson and his wife, Emily, enjoy spending time with their young daughter and their dog. He enjoys the beach, fishing, hiking, skiing, cycling, and attending various sporting events. fields.Board Certification: Board Certified by the American Board of Otolaryngology-Head and Neck Surgery Mitchell Isaac, MD is a board-certified Otolaryngology-head and neck surgeon. Doctor Isaac completed his undergraduate education at Presbyterian College graduating in 2013, with Honors Summa Cum Laude with a degree in physics. Doctor Isaac continued his post-graduate education at the Medical University of South Carolina(MUSC), graduating with a medical doctorate degree and achieving numerous academic honors along the way. Doctor Isaac completed his residency training in Otolaryngology-Head and Neck Surgery at MUSC in 2022. During his last year of training at MUSC, he served as a chief resident. Throughout residency, he received many accolades and conducted award-winning research in the field of ear surgery. Several of his research endeavors resulted in publications. Throughout his time as a resident at MUSC, the otolaryngology residency training program there consistently ranked within the top 10 in the country according to Doximity. Upon completion of his training, Doctor Isaac passed all examinations and completed all requirements set forth by the American Board of Otolaryngology, and is officially a board-certified Otolaryngologist. At Conway Medical Center Ear, Nose, and Throat, Dr. Isaac is a staff Otolaryngologist-Head and Neck Surgeon. He practices the full breadth of general Otolaryngology for the adult and pediatric population. Dr. Isaac's clinical and surgical interests include, but are not limited to: ear pathology and ear surgery; eardrum repair surgery; sensorineural and conductive hearing loss; dizziness/vertigo; sleep disordered breathing/obstructive sleep apnea; thyroid surgery; parathyroid surgery; head and neck cancer; salivary gland pathology and surgery; nasal airway surgery; and sinus surgery. Outside of work, Dr. Isaac enjoys spending time with his wife and daughter, exercising/weightlifting, boating, and traveling.

Following medical school, Dr. Beck completed his orthopaedic surgery residency at Thomas Jefferson University Hospital in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania learning from the orthopaedic surgeons from the Rothman Orthopaedic Institute. fields.Medical School: Nova Southeastern University 2019
fields.Residency: Philadelphia College of Osteopathic Medicine 2024

bio:
Efstratios “Drew” Papadelis DO is a board eligible and fellowship trained Orthopedic Trauma surgeon practicing at Grand Strand Medical Center in Myrtle Beach, SC.

Dr. Papadelis chose to specialize in orthopedic trauma surgery due to a deep passion for restoring mobility and function to patients who have suffered severe musculoskeletal injuries. Drawn to the specialty by the complexity of fracture management and the ability to make an immediate, life-changing impact, Dr. Papadelis thrives in high-pressure environments where rapid decision-making and technical precision are essential. The challenge of treating complex fractures, polytrauma cases, and post-traumatic complications further solidified the commitment to this field, where every case presents a unique opportunity to improve a patient’s quality of life.

Dr. Papadelis’ primary focus is on the treatment of acute fractures sustained from a variety of injuries ranging from high energy motor vehicle accidents to ground level falls. Specializing in procedures including open reduction and internal fixation (ORIF), external fixation, limb salvage, and complex periarticular reconstructions, Dr. Papadelis also provides expertise in managing post-traumatic complications such as non-unions, malunions, and infections. Additionally, a strong emphasis is placed on post-operative rehabilitation planning to ensure patients achieve the best possible functional outcomes.

What sets Dr. Papadelis apart is a commitment to delivering cutting-edge, patient-centered care by utilizing the latest advancements in orthopedic trauma surgery. With expertise in managing the most complex musculoskeletal injuries, Dr. Papadelis integrates minimally invasive techniques, biologic therapies, and personalized treatment strategies to optimize recovery. Beyond the operating room, collaboration with multidisciplinary teams ensures comprehensive care that prioritizes both immediate stabilization and long-term function. This dedication to innovation, precision, and holistic patient care distinguishes Dr. Papadelis in the field, ensuring that patients not only heal but regain the highest possible quality of life.

bio:
Mark R. Borowicz, MD, FACS is a board-certified general and vascular surgeon practicing at Grand Strand Surgical Care in Myrtle Beach, SC.

Dr. Borowicz went into general and vascular surgery to be able to surgically treat a variety of challenging patients. Dr. Borowicz provides open and laparoscopic surgeries such as: colectomies, laparoscopic cholecystectomies, open and laparoscopic inguinal hernia repairs, open ventral hernia repairs, skin cancer excisions, soft tissue tumor excisions, chemo ports, carotid endarterectomies, open and endovascular aneurysm repairs, femoral endarterectomies, femoral-popliteal bypasses, angiography with stents/atherectomies, amputations of toes, feet and legs, and venous closure procedures. He also runs, as the clinical director, a vascular laboratory offering carotid, AAA, PVD and venous studies. What sets Dr. Borowicz apart is he was the first board certified vascular surgeon in Horry County in 1996 and beyond.

Dr. Borowicz earned his medical degree from Bowman-Gray School of Medicine in Winston-Salem, NC, USA, and completed his residency in general surgery from the Medical University of SC in Charleston, SC, USA. After residency, Dr. Borowicz completed a vascular surgery fellowship at Vanderbilt University in Nashville, TN, USA.

bio: Dr. Scott Mayhew completed his Interventional Pain Management fellowship at Beth Israel Medical Center/Albert Einstein College of Medicine, an ACGME accredited Anesthesia based program in Manhattan. He is Board Certified in Pain Management and Emergency Medicine. He completed Residency training in Emergency Medicine at Michigan State University/GRMEP. Having taken care of thousands of patients with all types of pain during his 11 years as an Emergency Physician uniquely qaulified him for pain fellowship training, and gives him a broad and unique background in Pain Management. Dr. Mayhew is located at our Socastee Primary Care Center. He practices Interventional Pain Management exclusively, specializing in minimally invasive treatment modalities for sciatica, lower back pain, spinal stenosis, neck pain, joint pain, and spinal pain of multiple origins. He also treats painful peripheral neuropathies such as occipital neuralgia, lateral femoral cutaneous (skin) neuralgia, facial neuralgias, Reflex Sympathetic Dystrophy (RSD), migraines and other intractable pain syndromes. Dr. Mayhew has been trained in the latest state-of-the-art therapeutic options, including but not limited to minimally invasive spinal surgery, epiderals, nerve blocks, joint injections, radiofrequency ablation, and spinal cord stimulation for pain management. Dr. Mayhew is a member of the American Society of Interventional Pain Physicians, American Pain Society, International Association for the Study of Pain, as well as the American Board of Emergency Medicine. Appointments are on a referral only basis, and can be scheduled by calling (843) 497-5929.
